newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P assigns A2 to Yukong's Euro commercial paper.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns A2 to Yukong's Euro commercial paper.

text.p: Standard & Poor's Corp (S&P) said on Wednesday it had assigned an A2 short-term rating to Yukong Ltd's $200 million Euro commercial paper programme.

S&P said the rating reflected the strong market position of Yukong, South Korea's largest oil refiner, and the expectation that it would remain competitive even after expected deregulation of the oil industry.
But the rating firm also pointed to negative factors such as potential industry-wide excess supply and the company's sizable debt usage.
